items.text: Saquon Barkley ruled OUT for Week 5 (hamstring) along with Tank Bigsby; ETR flags Will Shipley show potential vs JAX.
items.why: Missed all practice; hamstring from Week 4
items.implication: Eagles RB room depleted; volume to next man up
items.opportunity: Lead back snaps/carries/routes for remaining healthy RBs

items.implication: Ravens offense downgrade; backup QB start
items.opportunity: Increased targets for Flowers/Andrews/Likely in pass game

items.text: DeVonta Smith OUT (hamstring) with Barkley and Hollywood Brown.
items.implication: Eagles WR corps thin; Goedert/Wicks upside
items.opportunity: Routes/targets for Dallas Goedert and Dontayvion Wicks

items.text: Jeremiyah Love listed IN; not on final injury report after limited/maintenance for ankle.
items.implication: Expected to play with expanded role possible

items.text: Chargers ruled out WR Quentin Johnston (among others including Alt, James).
Breece Hall OUT (quad) for second straight week.
items.implication: Jets RB committee or backup lead

items.opportunity: Targets for McLaurin if active or others

items.text: Jayden Daniels listed IN and expected back.
Love projected 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier; expects much bigger/better role this week despite ankle maintenance and prior usage drag criticism, while accounting for downside.
items.why: Media/fan pressure on prior low usage; not on IR; gut on role expansion
items.implication: Strong RB start/DFS play with clear lead over backup
items.conflict: Ankle maintenance risk and long-year fatigue possible

items.opportunity: If OUT, Raiders RB handcuff elevation

items.text: Fears multi-risk stack for Malik Nabers long-term (knee, shoulder, potential QB change to McCarthy, boomer coaching); frustration over low second-half targets noted but playing this week.
items.why: Sore knee DNP + shoulder + coaching/QB variables stacking
items.implication: Monitor closely; not pure sell but elevated risk

items.text: Loves Nico Collins vs TEN as WR8; volume and red-zone usage vs soft pass defense.
items.why: Target hog + matchup gift; red-zone volume

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; nickname push as target/fantasy gobbler, especially with possible Bengals WR injuries.
items.why: Workload + soft RB matchup; WR injury cascade potential

items.text: Hates Jalen Hurts vs JAX (London) as QB15; rough stretch and banged-up line.
items.why: Recent form + OL issues + London spot
items.implication: Fade or sit if better options
